message: We need a better way to connect clients with freelancers and keep project work from getting messy and hard to manage.
Who are the different users or roles that will use this system?

We have a few distinct roles involved in making everything run smoothly, starting with the clients who post the work and the freelancers who actually execute it. On top of that, we need oversight for administrators to manage disputes, verify profiles, and keep the marketplace trustworthy overall. Everyone needs to see only what's relevant to them so the workflow stays clean and practical.
Do you operate from a single location or multiple locations or branches?

We're actually managing a growing network of pharmacy branches right now, not just a single spot. That means whatever we build needs to let us keep an eye on operations across different locations without creating local chaos.
How do you currently track your inventory, records, or data, and what problems come up?

Right now we're mostly relying on a mix of local spreadsheets and manual counts at each branch, which gets messy fast. It is way too easy to miss stock levels or lose track of batch information and expiry dates before it becomes a real waste problem. We need something much more centralized so we aren't constantly fighting blind spots across our locations.
Walk me through what happens in your core daily workflow from start to finish.

Our day usually kicks off with prescriptions coming in either through the counter or online, and our technicians start processing them while pharmacists review the clinical details. We have to check stock across our branches right away, log any repeat fills, and handle restricted medications with strict sign-offs. Everything wraps up at the end of the day with cashiers reconciling their registers and managers running reports so we can keep our inventory and sales aligned for the next shift.
How do payments or transactions get handled and reconciled today?

Right now, cashiers and branch managers handle retail sales and insurance reimbursements locally, then patch everything together at the end of the day. It involves a lot of manual register reconciliation and cross-checking spreadsheets, which eats up time and makes it hard to get a clear, real-time financial picture across all our locations. We need a much tighter, centralized way to track transactions so we aren't chasing down discrepancies after hours.
What reporting or visibility do you need across the business?

I really need visibility into sales trends, stock movement, and overall branch performance so I can make practical management decisions. Right now it takes too long to pull that data together, and I want to see how each location is doing at a glance without having to chase down reports from every manager.
What other tools or systems does this need to work with?

Right now we have a mix of local POS terminals at the counters and whatever accounting software our bookkeeper uses, but they don't really talk to each other well. Whatever we put in place needs to plug smoothly into those existing tools without causing a massive disruption during busy hours, since our staff doesn't have time for a complicated tech overhaul.
